title: The last January walk
logline: The alley in January rain, the pup at twelve walking it slowly, the man matching him, both from behind, the beer sign's puddle. The last January page in the book. Nothing marks it.

panels.composition: A gravel alley in January rain with an old three-legged dog walking slowly and a man in plaid matching its pace, both from behind, a beer sign's neon in a puddle ahead.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a gravel alley in January rain with an old three-legged dog walking slowly and a man in plaid flannel matching its pace both seen from behind, a beer sign's neon in a puddle ahead, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
